Connecting Captions needs Accessibility permission to type Transcription into other apps. Theater captions on your screen do not require this.
Connecting Captions needs microphone access to caption speech on this Mac. Audio stays on this Mac unless you opt in to a cloud AI provider.
Connecting Captions needs permission to control system events for managing launch at startup settings.
Connecting Captions uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your voice and translate it locally.
